critical_dimensions.product_meaning: Information hierarchy; natural-language request and durable paper object; current task before history.
critical_dimensions.action_clarity: Exact clarification and primary answer visible on 390px without traversing history; clear return from notification.
critical_dimensions.async_truth: Observed state or next scheduled opportunity, no fake completion time/progress; truthful loading, error and unsent state.
critical_dimensions.durable_retrieval: Global historical retrieval, distinguishing identity, full dates, bounded continuation and history context.
critical_dimensions.output_continuity: Completed version remains available with active revision; separate paper/key; immutable selected output identity carried to print.
critical_dimensions.mobile_layout: 320/390px reachability, readable controls and typography, no horizontal dependency, useful action hierarchy.
critical_dimensions.visual_craft: Compact density, readable typography, coherent composition and visual continuity with selected C.

coverage_note: Forty normalized formal states drawn from the required core desktop/mobile, narrow 320px, retrieval, output, loading/error/empty categories. Parent personally viewed all forty plus five supplementary final captures; critic all seventy-three. QA review here means source/render identity and functional checks, not an invented personal visual score. Two PDF state checks refer to actual page rasters; browser errors and DOM overflow are not applicable to static PDF pages. No broken image is visible in these text-paper fixtures.

visual_critic.reason: New paper presents one real free-text request. Register and record foreground the paper, exact action and separate completed outputs. The empty Mine state now explains creator scope and provides an appropriate direct action. At 390px the complete marks-conflict question, answer field and Send reply fit before request/history; the same order holds at 320px. Notification selection closes Updates and reveals the destination title and active clarification. Blank-query Mine no longer instructs trying different search words. Next opportunity includes date and IST, and explanatory copy distinguishes a start opportunity from completion. Waiting after an earlier opportunity is acknowledged. Loading, query failure, no results and failed submission have visibly different explanations. The failed-send capture retains the actual input. Legacy output explicitly says Version not recorded. Two identical long academic titles retain distinct shortened IDs and full 2024/2022 dates, with Copy ID in detail. Continue search shows 59 loaded records and the exhausted result shows all 65. History shows 150 activity/100 request context, then 161/161 and beginning reached, including the 2011 original at desktop. Whole-word and eight-word limitations remain explicit. The science record simultaneously shows Version 1 ready and Request 2 queued, with separate links and an active revision section. Paper/key viewer and actual PDF page rasters show the same saved paper ID visual-v1-geography-v1 and recorded Version 1, with clearly separate student and teacher content. Fixture inspection links that immutable saved row to the originating geography record and request revision 1. Saved paper ID is honestly the artifact identity, not mislabeled as the conversation identity. All four register views and Bank tools remain visible. Text and long titles wrap within one column; reply and output controls remain legible at 320px. Narrow notification return exposes the current object. Desktop rows translate into stacked records rather than compressed columns. The saved viewer now uses the same green controls, quiet paper background, typography and reduced navigation as the record journey. The redundant Saved paper hero and blue tab layer are removed. Document-level headings and identity remain distinct from the workspace controls. Amber clarification, green saved output and restrained failure treatment carry actual meaning.
generic_cues: justified: They separate different objects and actions; the older version does not masquerade as the active request.

resolved: Current shell removes the extra hero and aligns the controls with the green workspace. Repeated document title inside the immutable printable page is purposeful, not another competing app hero.
justified: Simple status content matches an operational register. Copy now distinguishes blank creator scope, a searched no-match result, loading and failed access.

parent.reason: Paper records have searchable stable identity, dates and four visible status views. Desktop rows and narrow stacked records retain the same purpose without a growing selector. The current clarification question precedes its answer field and named Send reply action. Selecting an update exposes this task without the old popover covering it. A saved version remains usable while the revision is queued; the original/current requirement and older activity remain discoverable on the same record. New paper has one text entry with the necessary academic and paper inputs described. Failed saving retains that text; query failure, loading and creator-filtered emptiness have distinct messages and recoveries. Search results visibly distinguish old same-titled records by dates and IDs. End-of-results and beginning-of-history states make retrieval limits clear. Scale claims rely separately on QA, not these visual observations. Saved student paper and teacher key are distinct and carry recorded output identity/version into actual print output. Unknown legacy versions remain explicit. 320px views have readable current actions and visible Bank tools; color reinforces textual states without substituting for them. Additional direct desktop/mobile inspections confirm current failures and empty search states offer appropriate recovery, saved viewer remains coherent across widths, and long historical records retain actionable controls and continuation/end context.
generic_cues: justified: Panels distinguish actionable clarification, available saved outputs and active revisions.
resolved: Titles, state labels and touch controls remain readable in the inspected narrow states.
justified: Restrained green and amber correspond to actual outcomes. No decorative charts or fabricated progress obscure work.

Current reviewer verified exact final source and affected runtime/readiness tests, gateway, publication and isolated register integration; known local transport/runtime limits are preserved. Production deployment/recovery is not established by these local results.
